# Account Owners: Update an Existing Taxbit Account Owner

Area overview and notes: [account-owners.md](../account-owners.md)

`PATCH /account-owners/{id}` · tenant-scoped token

Update an existing Account Owner in Taxbit's system.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account Owner. |

**Request body** (required, JSON)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_owner_type` | string | No | The type of Account Owner. One of: `INDIVIDUAL`, `ENTITY`, `INTERMEDIARY`. |
| `name` | string | No | Account Owner's full name. Nullable. |
| `email` | string | No | Account Owner's email address. Nullable. |
| `phone` | string | No | Account Owner's phone number. Nullable. |
| `valid_self_certification_on_file` | boolean | No | Whether a valid self-certification is on file for the Account Owner. When a self-certification tax document is on file, this reflects the latest self-certification's validation status; otherwise it reflects the value you provided. Nullable. |
| `birth_date` | string (date) | No | ISO-8601 date when the Account Owner was born. Nullable. |
| `tin` | string | No | Account Owner's TIN. **Deprecated.** Nullable. |
| `tin_type` | string | No | The type of TIN. One of: `US_SSN`, `US_EIN`, `US_ATIN`, `US_ITIN`, `SSN`, `EIN`, `ATIN`, `ITIN`, `OTHER`. **Deprecated.** Nullable. |
| `tax_country_code` | string | No | The two-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the country the Account Owner is subject to taxes in. **Deprecated.** Nullable. |
| `tax_residencies` | array of object | No | A list of the Account Owner's tax residencies. Set to null to clear all existing tax residencies. Nullable. |

| `tax_residencies[].tin` | string | No | The Account Owner's Taxpayer Identification Number for this tax residency. |

| `tax_residencies[].tin_not_required_reason` | string | No | The reason a TIN is not required for this tax residency. One of: `NOT_ISSUED`, `NOT_REQUIRED`, `OTHER`. |
| `tax_residencies[].tin_not_required_reason_other` | string | No | Additional explanation for why a TIN is not required, used when tin_not_required_reason is OTHER. |

Example request body:

```json
{"name":"John Anthony Boush","email":"john.boush@email.com","phone":"(123) 456-7890","birth_date":"2020-08-19","tin":"123-45-6789","tax_country_code":"US","us_tin":"123-45-6789","prefers_physical_mail":false,"is_tax_exempt":false,"birth_city":"Seattle","birth_country":"US","vat_country_code":"DE","vat_id":"58694837384","business_registration_country_code":"DE","business_registration_number":"5968574","financial_account_id":"6968473","financial_account_holder_name":"John Anthony Boush","giin":"123456.99999.SL.528"}
```

**Response 200**: Account Owner Successfully Updated

Returns the submitted body under `data`, plus:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | Yes |  |
| `data.id` | string | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the Account Owner. |
| `data.taxbit_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | The Taxbit ID for this object. This is a version 4 UUID. |
| `data.tenant_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | Tenant ID for your organization. |
| `data.date_created` | string (date-time) | Yes | The date when the account owner was created in Taxbit's system. |
| `data.date_modified` | string | Yes |  |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 403 Forbidden · 404 Not Found · 429 Too Many Requests
